name: Openbroca
tagline: Native Mac dictation that turns speech into clean text
description: Openbroca is a native Swift dictation app for macOS that turns spoken thoughts into cleaned-up text in the app you are using. It is designed for writing messages, emails, notes and prompts without switching to a separate transcription editor. A personal dictionary learns from corrections to improve recognition of names and specialized terms. The app supports dictation in 30 languages and translation into 28 output languages. Openbroca requires macOS 15 or later and supports both Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Recognition and text cleanup use cloud processing, so an internet connection is required; Openbroca does not store audio. The freemium plan includes all features and 3,000 text units per week without a credit card. The current Swift app is separate from the older open-source Electron project, Openbroca Origin. Submitted by the founder, Timothy Lau.
